prerequisites: Has a basic knowledge concerning metallurgical processes of treatment of ores, production of steel and non-ferrous metals, has a basic knowledge about mechanical properties of engineer materials, organized knowledge about types of metallic engineer materials, its composition, properties, applications and rules of its right choice.

Has a detailed knowledge about structures of steel and cast iron, rules of its classification and description, has a basic knowledge about thermal and thermo-mechanical treatment, knowledge about alloyed steels and non-ferrous metals and its alloys, has the theoretical knowledge about electric circuits.

Can analyze macrostructures of materials, technological imperfections, can estimate features of microstructure of metals, can identify phases using the balance curves, can distinguish microstructures according to amount of carbon in steel, influence of thermal treatment, can analyze electric circuits, understands technical drawings, can prepare technical documentation

learning_outcomes.text: Getting of basic knowledge about joining of metals with use of welding methods.
Getting of skills of the right choice of joining and basic parameters of the process.

Obtaining and keeping of social competences concerning ability to cooperate in the student
’s group with a goal to solve problems effective way. Responsible, honest and serious approach to new duties, respecting customs of academic society
Knows types of joints, welding positions, description of joints, reasons of cracking of joints
Knows basic methods of welding and parameters of the process
Has the knowledge concerning metallurgy of welding processes, brazing/soldering, pressure joining and thermal cutting
Can define basic parameters of welding, describe basic properties of welding equipment and make a right choice of consumables
Can define basic parameters of brazing/soldering and resistance welding, describe basic properties of welding equipment and make a right choice of consumables
Can define basic parameters of thermal cutting, analyze influence of cutting on properties of the cutting surface and precision of following of the shape
Shows ability necessary to cooperate in a team with a goal to improve methods of right strategy of optimal solving of problems
Is able to assess properly ratios, explain and justify his own point of view with use of a knowledge concerning basic matters of material science.
Respects customs and rules of academic society

syllabus_topics: Organization of the lecture, Safety in welding, Types of welds and joints, welding positions
Basics of metallurgy of welding processes
Fuel gas welding of steel, cast iron and non-ferrous metals
Basic information about arc welding
Shielded manual metal arc welding
Gas shielded tungsten arc welding
Gas shielded metal arc welding GMAW
Submerged arc welding and electroslag welding
Welding with use of concentrated energy sources
Brazing and soldering. Braze welding
Thermal oxygen, plasma and laser cutting. Water cutting
Resistance pressure joining, Friction welding
Hardfacing and thermal spraying
Stresses and deformations in welding. Thermal treatment of welded joints
Acceptance tests of welded structure. Quality systems in welding
Organization of the lab. Safety in welding. Fuel gas welding of steel
Brazing and soldering of steel, copper and aluminum
Resistance pressure joining Friction welding
Shielded manual metal arc welding
Gas shielded tungsten and metal arc welding
Stresses and deformations in welding. Submerged arc welding
Thermal oxygen and plasma cutting. Robotic welding
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: The final grade for the lecture is based on a final test. The final grade for the laboratory is the average of verbal answers and short tests.
